name: inspector
description: Amazon Inspector Amazon Inspector enables you to analyze the behavior of your AWS resources and to identify potential security issues.

subcommands.name: add-attributes-to-findings
subcommands.description: Assigns attributes (key and value pairs) to the findings that are specified by the ARNs of the findings.

subcommands.name: create-assessment-target
subcommands.description: Creates a new assessment target using the ARN of the resource group that is generated by CreateResourceGroup.

subcommands.name: create-assessment-template
subcommands.description: Creates an assessment template for the assessment target that is specified by the ARN of the assessment target.

subcommands.name: create-exclusions-preview
subcommands.description: Starts the generation of an exclusions preview for the specified assessment template.

subcommands.name: create-resource-group
subcommands.description: Creates a resource group using the specified set of tags (key and value pairs) that are used to select the EC2 instances to be included in an Amazon Inspector assessment target.

subcommands.name: delete-assessment-run
subcommands.description: Deletes the assessment run that is specified by the ARN of the assessment run.

subcommands.name: delete-assessment-target
subcommands.description: Deletes the assessment target that is specified by the ARN of the assessment target.

subcommands.name: delete-assessment-template
subcommands.description: Deletes the assessment template that is specified by the ARN of the assessment template.

subcommands.name: describe-assessment-runs
subcommands.description: Describes the assessment runs that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment runs.

subcommands.name: describe-assessment-targets
subcommands.description: Describes the assessment targets that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment targets.

subcommands.name: describe-assessment-templates
subcommands.description: Describes the assessment templates that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment templates.

subcommands.name: describe-cross-account-access-role
subcommands.description: Describes the IAM role that enables Amazon Inspector to access your AWS account.

subcommands.name: describe-exclusions
subcommands.description: Describes the exclusions that are specified by the exclusions' ARNs.

subcommands.name: describe-findings
subcommands.description: Describes the findings that are specified by the ARNs of the findings.

subcommands.name: describe-resource-groups
subcommands.description: Describes the resource groups that are specified by the ARNs of the resource groups.

subcommands.name: describe-rules-packages
subcommands.description: Describes the rules packages that are specified by the ARNs of the rules packages.

subcommands.name: get-assessment-report
subcommands.description: Produces an assessment report that includes detailed and comprehensive results of a specified assessment run.

subcommands.name: get-exclusions-preview
subcommands.description: Retrieves the exclusions preview (a list of ExclusionPreview objects) specified by the preview token.

subcommands.name: get-telemetry-metadata
subcommands.description: Information about the data that is collected for the specified assessment run.

subcommands.name: list-assessment-run-agents
subcommands.description: Lists the agents of the assessment runs that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment runs.

subcommands.name: list-assessment-runs
subcommands.description: Lists the assessment runs that correspond to the assessment templates that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment templates.

subcommands.name: list-assessment-targets
subcommands.description: Lists the ARNs of the assessment targets within this AWS account.

subcommands.name: list-assessment-templates
subcommands.description: Lists the assessment templates that correspond to the assessment targets that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment targets.

subcommands.name: list-event-subscriptions
subcommands.description: Lists all the event subscriptions for the assessment template that is specified by the ARN of the assessment template.

subcommands.name: list-exclusions
subcommands.description: List exclusions that are generated by the assessment run.

subcommands.name: list-findings
subcommands.description: Lists findings that are generated by the assessment runs that are specified by the ARNs of the assessment runs.

subcommands.name: list-rules-packages
subcommands.description: Lists all available Amazon Inspector rules packages.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags associated with an assessment template.

subcommands.name: preview-agents
subcommands.description: Previews the agents installed on the EC2 instances that are part of the specified assessment target.

subcommands.name: register-cross-account-access-role
subcommands.description: Registers the IAM role that grants Amazon Inspector access to AWS Services needed to perform security assessments.

subcommands.name: remove-attributes-from-findings
subcommands.description: Removes entire attributes (key and value pairs) from the findings that are specified by the ARNs of the findings where an attribute with the specified key exists.

subcommands.name: set-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Sets tags (key and value pairs) to the assessment template that is specified by the ARN of the assessment template.

subcommands.name: start-assessment-run
subcommands.description: Starts the assessment run specified by the ARN of the assessment template.

subcommands.name: stop-assessment-run
subcommands.description: Stops the assessment run that is specified by the ARN of the assessment run.

subcommands.name: subscribe-to-event
subcommands.description: Enables the process of sending Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) notifications about a specified event to a specified SNS topic.

subcommands.name: unsubscribe-from-event
subcommands.description: Disables the process of sending Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) notifications about a specified event to a specified SNS topic.

subcommands.name: update-assessment-target
subcommands.description: Updates the assessment target that is specified by the ARN of the assessment target.
